littleThings.back: The one that makes a room feel a little warmer.
The sound that can make an ordinary moment feel golden.
All your little reactions and the way you are unmistakably you.
I love the person you are, not just the happiness you bring me.
The small, ridiculous things that only we would understand.
The thoughtful things you do, even when you think no one notices.
Even a normal day can be something I remember fondly.
You don’t have to be anything other than yourself to be special to me.

notes.text: I love the way the tiniest memories become the biggest feelings.
You deserve to be celebrated for exactly who you are.
I hope we find more reasons to laugh, even on the ordinary days.
More listening. More gentleness. More understanding.

letter:
Dear Que,

Happy 21st birthday, my sweet Buttercup. ♡

I made this little scrapbook because I wanted you to have something that feels like a soft place to land, a collection of the beautiful little things that remind me of you.

I also don't want to pretend that everything between us has been easy. We've been fighting for more than a month, and I know a website can't undo hurt feelings or make everything okay. I'm sorry for the ways I've hurt you, for the moments I haven't listened well enough, and for the times our conversations have felt heavier than they should.

You deserve to be heard, respected, and loved with patience. I want to do better at that, and I know it takes real actions, not just pretty words. This gift isn't me asking you to forget what happened or to forgive me on a deadline. Please take all the space and time you need.

But today is your birthday, and above everything else, I want you to feel celebrated. I hope your twenty-first year is filled with peace, laughter, and every little thing that makes you happy.

Thank you for being part of my life, Haziqah.

With love,
Luqman Hakimi ♡
